title: Palace of the Dukes of Braganza
scope: The present Guimarães ducal palace with its four granite wings, open arcaded court, projecting chapel and towers, steep clay roofs, and cylindrical brick chimneys.
limitations: The footprint and court are tied to the named map geometry. Roof ridges, tower heights, the arrangement of minor openings and the positions of chimneys outside the photographed court view are estimated.
The four wings, chapel projection, two-level courtyard galleries, and cylindrical brick chimneys are modeled externally. Interior collections, ornaments and the adjacent castle are outside scope.
